description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker diffusion-gemma-nvfp4 recipe for NVIDIA's DiffusionGemma-26B-A4B-it-NVFP4 (ModelOpt NVFP4; checkpoint revision ec4ff3df), Apache-2.0, served by vLLM on a single Spark. Runs eugr's published vllm-node image (nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM 0.30.1rc1.dev336+gaf5b4857e and FlashInfer 4a638133) with upstream's launch: block-diffusion decoding (canvas length 256), TRITON_ATTN attention, fastsafetensors loading, prefix caching, gemma4 reasoning and tool-call parsers, 262,144-token context and memory utilisation 0.8 (upstream defaults); upstream sets no sequence limit, so vLLM's default applies. Upstream's diffusiongemma mod is applied at image build time: it skips its vLLM patches because the pinned image already contains DiffusionGemma support and only installs its no-thinking chat template at /workspace/vllm/fixed_chat_template.jinja, which the recipe passes by absolute path (upstream uses a path relative to its working directory). Thinking is an option: the default is upstream's diffusion-gemma-nvfp4 (thinking off, fixed chat template); the other choice is eugr's diffusion-gemma-nvfp4-thinking recipe (enable_thinking true with the checkpoint's own chat template). The upstream recipe is solo-only. No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B NVFP4 vLLM single Spark (eugr)
